response.sql:
WITH funding_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing') AS funding_source,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ss.boxy IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz != 0 
            THEN ss.boxy / ss.boxz
            END) AS avg_ratio,
    SUM(ss.volm3) AS total_size
  FROM scanspatial ss
  JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing')
),
average_size_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(total_size) AS overall_average_size
  FROM funding_stats
)
SELECT 
  AVG(fs.avg_ratio) AS average_of_ratios,
  SUM(fs.total_size) AS combined_size,
  AVG(fs.total_size - asc.overall_average_size) AS average_excess
FROM funding_stats fs
CROSS JOIN average_size_calc asc
WHERE fs.total_size > asc.overall_average_size

assumptions.assumption: "Size" for each funding source is the sum of volumes (volm3). This interprets "how big it is" as the total scanned volume across all spatial records for that funding source.
NULL funding sources are treated as a distinct group labeled 'Missing', per the request to "treat a missing source as its own group".
When calculating the ratio boxy/boxz, records where either value is NULL or where boxz equals 0 are excluded (ignoring missing values).

alternatives.interpretation: "Size" is the count of spatial records per funding source, not the sum of volumes. This interprets "bigger than average" funding sources as those with more scan records.
